criteria.criterion: gh/transport.rs holds the Transport-row items; their text matches the text removed from gh/mod.rs apart from visibility and use lines, visible in git diff.
criteria.evidence: transport.rs holds all 13 items in the Transport row of structure-pass.md section 2.1: Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog. In the color-moved diff, every removed line in mod.rs is colored as moved (1;35m) except the athena_data::records use line. I also compared the removed block with the new file line by line. The only differences are the new //! header and use lines, and `fn clock_entropy` becoming `pub(super) fn clock_entropy`, which is a visibility change.

criteria.criterion: gh/mod.rs declares the transport module and re-exports every moved item, so existing paths such as crate::gh::Runner remain valid.
criteria.evidence: mod.rs now has `mod transport;` and `pub use transport::{CurlHttp, GhCli, GhFailure, HostErrorLog, HttpPost, HttpReply, Retry, Runner, is_transient, parse_status, retry_transient, transient_text};`, which covers all 12 public items. The private clock_entropy is brought in with `use transport::clock_entropy;` because GhClient calls it at mod.rs:449. Callers outside gh/ still compile through these paths: athena-cli main.rs, drain.rs and tests, plus reconcile.rs, watcher.rs and host_rules.rs. The recorded clippy --all-targets and test runs passed.

criteria.criterion: A Grep the verifier runs shows no file outside crates/athena-core/src/gh/ names a moved item by an old module path (e.g. gh::transport::X where it was gh::X).
criteria.evidence: I used the Grep tool, not Bash. Pattern `gh::transport|transport::(Runner|GhCli|...|HostErrorLog)` over the whole repository: one hit, `use transport::clock_entropy;` at crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs:38, which is inside gh/. Pattern `gh::(Runner|GhCli|GhFailure|retry_transient|HostErrorLog)` over crates/ (the section 5.1 G2 grep): 11 hits in 7 files, all outside gh/. git diff --stat shows none of those 7 files changed, so the count is the same before and after.

summary: The change passes. All 13 items in the Transport row (`Runner`, `GhCli`, `GhFailure`, `parse_status`, `is_transient`, `transient_text`, `Retry`, `retry_transient`, `clock_entropy`, `HttpReply`, `HttpPost`, `CurlHttp`, `HostErrorLog`) now live in `crates/athena-core/src/gh/transport.rs`. Their text is unchanged except for new use lines, a module comment, and `clock_entropy` becoming `pub(super)`. Git's moved-line coloring marks the whole removed block as moved. `gh/mod.rs` declares `mod transport` and re-exports every public item, so paths like `crate::gh::Runner` work as before. The test code changed only by two needed import lines. The Grep finds no `gh::transport::` path outside `gh/`, and the section 5.1 G2 grep still finds 11 hits in 7 files, none of which changed. Athena's records show fmt, clippy and the full test suite (1396 tests) passed, and I ran the two G2 proof tests and the external-calls guard myself; all passed. CHANGELOG.md has a G2 entry under Unreleased stating no behavior change. Only the three expected files changed. One caveat: I could not list the tests on the base commit, because that needs a checkout I am not allowed to do. That the lists match follows from the diff, which adds, removes or renames no test.
